stage: A1 — offline PCAP input and Ethernet/IPv4/TCP/UDP parsing
acceptance_criterion: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md A1: reproduce correct fields and harmless handling of damaged input using fixed PCAP/packet bytes.
scope: Review the existing A1 implementation and execute acceptance checks. No production or test code changes in this A1 review; previous A0 changes retained.

review.evidence: PcapSource tests; direct normal, mixed and empty PCAP runs

review.criterion: Correct Ethernet/IPv4/TCP/UDP fields and payload bounds
review.evidence: 27 PacketParser tests; direct normal CLI metadata with fixed addresses, ports, timestamps, lengths and TCP fields
All truncated prefixes, IHL/total-length/TCP-offset/UDP-length/caplen checks; mixed.pcap skips the bad frame and continues to UDP
IPv6/ARP/VLAN/fragment/IP-protocol tests; unsupported link type exits 1

review.criterion: Container/file failures are not successful analyses
review.evidence: Truncated container and missing file tests; direct truncated.pcap exits 1 without pcap_summary
PcapCli tests cover no raw payload, output failure and buffered flush failure

checks.name: Fresh Debug build and full CTest
Fresh ASan/UBSan A1 subset
checks.breakdown: 27 parser + 13 source + 8 PCAP CLI + 6 fixture/process tasks

interfaces_reviewed: read_pcap(path, callback), callback-scoped borrowed bytes, unique_ptr pcap_close deleter
limitations: Offline Ethernet IPv4 TCP/UDP only. Live input and NFQUEUE are later stages.
IPv6, VLAN, ARP, IP fragments and other IP protocols are skipped/rejected according to documented policy.
Checksums and application protocol semantics are not validated.
PCAPNG, other libpcap versions and arbitrary corrupted inputs are not exhaustively verified.
No A2 implementation or real network blocking was performed.
The nonprivileged check covers one normal capture; a normal developer account and a full unprivileged test suite were not configured or tested.
